name: label
description: A native label with form typography and peer-disabled styling.

files.content:
---
/**
 * OpenUI Label — framework-native, zero runtime dependencies.
 *
 * Plain JavaScript frontmatter (no `lang="ts"`) so the same source installs
 * into TypeScript and JavaScript Astro projects. Types live in JSDoc.
 *
 * @typedef {Object} LabelProps
 * @property {string} [class]
 * @property {string} [for]
 */

const { class: className = "", ...rest } = Astro.props;

const BASE_CLASSES =
  "text-sm font-medium leading-none text-zinc-900 peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-70 dark:text-zinc-50";

const classes = [BASE_CLASSES, className].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
---

<label class={classes} {...rest}>
  <slot />
</label>
